text: Figure 6.5: Information path for the flash compare job error (internal flash) Note: Flash compare function is an internal mechanism for the Flash EEPROM Emulation to determine whether erasing / writing is needed or not. Compare job error is detected by HW (1). Flash Driver is the first SW module involved, and is responsible for the report to the DEM and to the Flash EEPROM Emulation (2) which have to reset some internal states in order to accept new requests.
